g.text: FedCM cross-site SSO with Auth0: RP app (other site) <-> Auth0 custom domain + FedCM Worker (IdP site)
Every Worker -> Auth0 request goes to the self-managed custom domain origin with
The Worker is stateless: the Auth0 session is the only source of truth.
Phase 0: user logs in on the same-site Login app (classic redirect, no FedCM)
Phase 1: RP app on another site asks for a FedCM credential
Phase 2: browser talks to the IdP (IdP does not learn the RP yet)
accounts_endpoint and login_url must be identical
in both files, or the browser aborts
[first FedCM sign-in to this RP in this browser]
[returning user (single account, >10 min since last auto sign-in, no preventSilentAccess)]
Phase 4: ID assertion = Auth0 authorization code for the RP's own client
Phase 5: RP finishes a standard Auth0 PKCE code exchange via the SDK
Alt: logged out at the IdP, user clicks "Sign in with ... (FedCM)"
/fedcm/login -> Universal Login under the BRIDGE client
